scope: conditional fixed-design Monte Carlo of static delta inference on all197 primary cases; not temporal-family474 calibration
master_calendar: all2483 observed B3 sessions2016-2025; recent1246 nested; paired masks unchanged
common80: same recent paths, not additional hypotheses
dgp: y=beta_base*m+delta*m*1(m>0)+sigma_asset*h_t*u_t; identical true intercepts0 but separate intercepts estimated
nuisance_calibration: OLS beta and sqrt(SSE/(n-2)) from observed N; decade for shared80, recent for remaining37; fixed per asset before simulation
cross_dependence: u innovations=sqrt(.3)*common+sqrt(.7)*asset_specific; same asset shocks reused across overlapping windows; no empirical covariance claim
heteroscedastic_scale: h_t=sqrt(.5+.5*lagged_market_squared/mean(master_market_squared)); first lag uses first m; normalized to mean(h^2)=1 on master calendar; applied after AR recursion

effect_patterns.sparse_assets: first12 of117 ordered by papel_id, fixed independently of p values; remaining effects0; no actual asset removed

methods.kernel: Bartlett on original session grid; n/(n-4); normal95%; no lag selection from simulation results

reuse: OLS linearity: exact delta injection shifts point estimate only; residuals and HAC variances unchanged; verify against independent full-design OLS before full run
performance: FWER among true nulls, undefined when none
power among true alternatives, undefined when none
panel_mcse: sd of replication-level mean over applicable assets /sqrt(R), never binomial over R*assets
family_policy: 197 per method/mechanism/effect pattern; simulations are method evaluations, not new discoveries; family474 unchanged
repetitions_rationale: R1000 gives largest binomial MCSE1.581 percentage points, MCSE0.689pp near5%; Wilson intervals reported even0/1000
reporting_policy: report all prespecified mechanisms/effects/methods, including undercoverage or size inflation; no power-derived economic threshold or retrospective observed power
